slots.node02.text: On day one the controller opens a single exceptions queue instead of a stack of spreadsheets. Each item shows the account, the amount, the likely cause and the person who owns the fix.
slots.node03.text: By the end of day two most items are cleared by the entity accountants. What remains are judgment calls: a reserve, a reclassification, a timing question. Those are the items a controller should spend time on.
slots.node04.text: Nothing waits for the end of the month to be looked at, so nothing arrives all at once.
slots.node07.text: Pilot entities cleared exceptions in two days on average, against nine days before the pilot.
slots.title: What changes for the controller
